data.data:
Please note that pre-season uphill travel is not allowed, as our Mountain Operations teams need to prepare the mountain for opening. We appreciate your cooperation and understanding.

Winter is BACK! This first storm has dropped a beautiful blanket of snow across the resort, and there is more in the forecast. We're getting excited for the season to start and gearing up for winter operations, with opening day scheduled for Friday, December 11, conditions permitting. Keep an eye on our Mountain Conditions page for updates as we get closer to the season.
